# Global Sources

> > Global Sources is a leading B2B marketplace and trade show organizer connecting international buyers with verified suppliers across China, Hong Kong, Vietnam, and worldwide markets.

The platform facilitates international trade through exhibitions, sourcing events, and supplier discovery services. Global Sources hosts major trade shows including Global Sources Discover, Global Sources Summit, and Global Sources MATCH, with events in Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, and Vietnam.

## Key Topics

- B2B sourcing and supplier discovery
- International trade exhibitions and trade shows
- China manufacturing and supplier networks
- Hong Kong and Vietnam trade events
- Global Sources Discover
- Global Sources Summit
- Global Sources MATCH
- CTIS China
- Sourcing Elite Board
- Cross-border commerce
- Verified supplier connections
- Trade fair organization
- Guangzhou manufacturing hub
- Global marketplace solutions

## Trade Shows & Exhibitions

- [Global Sources Exhibitions, Activities & Events: Bridging Markets Worldwide](https://exhibitions.globalsources.com/): Global Sources trade shows & exhibitions in Hong Kong, Vietnam & worldwide
